title: Kagamine Len — Heartfelt Performance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That was incredible, Len.
You played all the parts you were worried about so well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's right. Each note packed such a big punch. I got all excited just listening to you play!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I did practice those parts a ton.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, you seem way more motivated lately for some reason.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I've noticed that you've been practicing very late...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, who wouldn't feel motivated after seeing a show like the one we saw?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The performance Miku and Ichika put on made me want to learn to play better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come to think of it, the girls are officially pros now, right? What does that mean for them moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They have gone pro, but they've only just signed their contract. Apparently, there's still quite a lot that needs to be done before they make their big debut.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to seeing what they accomplish as professionals.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too.
And I hope their new chapter starts off on a really good note.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Their new chapter...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I really like the sound of that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, we should totally do something to cheer them on! Something that'll really pump them up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cheering them on seems fine, but what do you mean by “pumping them up”...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You know...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku-P, help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um... How about something fun and recreational? We could play hide and seek in the school or have a quiz tournament!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Saki might enjoy those...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
It'll be a nice break for them, and we should be able to have a fun time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(A nice break...
Yeah, the girls have been super busy lately.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (And they're only gonna get busier as they get ready to debut.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Hang on...
It's not like they're gonna have a lot of free time after they debut either, huh?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If anything, that's pretty much when they'll really start working as professional musicians...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Nothing's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I just realized that the girls are gonna be working even harder as musicians now that they're pros.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, that's very true.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, why don't we do something for them that'll encourage them to do their best as pros moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
For example...
We could put on a really amazing show for them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A show for them?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet it will get them excited about their future if we really put our minds to it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Just like how they lit this fire inside of me through their show!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! That's such an amazing idea!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. See what I mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm all for it.
A show does sound more fun than playing some games with them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, you don't have to be that brutally honest.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm for it as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree with Len that a show seems like the best way to motivate the girls.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate. I was actually looking forward to having a quiz tournament and playing hide and seek.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just forget about those, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're gonna put on a super awesome show that gets the girls really excited about their future!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.
